license: Original project-owned procedural artwork. No external asset sources.
runtime_format: CMH1: 4 byte magic, int32 vertex count, float32 position3 normal3 uv2; sequential triangles.

coordinate_contracts.stair: 12 steps, x -2..2, y 0..3, z -3..3; ascending toward +Z.
coordinate_contracts.terrace: Octagonal clipped-square deck x/z -4..4, top y .6.
coordinate_contracts.trees: Trunk and canopy names for one species share the same base-center pivot. Scale both identically.
coordinate_contracts.balcony: Top of deck at y0; support braces extend below; rail extends above.
coordinate_contracts.bridge: 8m along Z, width 3m; top deck arches from y0 at ends to y.4 in middle.
coordinate_contracts.sky_ring: Ring plane XZ, centered y0. Rotate X90 for vertical orientation.
coordinate_contracts.frontages: Arcade, portal, window, wall, sigil face -Z. Apply yaw at placement.
